notes.title: Additional voice updates (planned)
notes.content:
Hello, players!

With this update, [u][h1]voices will be added to some of the characters![/h1][/u]
Not all characters will have voices, but the important characters will have voices added, so please wait a little longer!
We hope you will enjoy the adventures in the evolved London and Tokyo even more!

And, we have a request for all of our players.
[h2]Because this update is so large, there is a possibility that your save data will be lost...[/h2]
Your save data is located in the
game folder
[windows]
・jououari241032_tyrano_auto_save.sav
・jououari241032_tyrano_data.sav
[mac]
・jououari241032_tyrano_auto_save.sav
・jououari241032_tyrano_data.sav
So, if you want to keep your save data, please copy it to your desktop or somewhere else!

The other update content is as follows.
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
- Added voices.
- Corrected some lines of dialogue.
- Translation has been corrected.
- Adjusted the difficulty of the mini-games in general.
- Improved the stability of the game.

[u][h3]The update is scheduled for December 27, 2024 at 3:00 p.m.(JST)![/h3][/u]
[u][h3]Please wait a little longer, we apologize for the inconvenience![/h3][/u]
